reason: Test-inventory producer for canary ci-ready (#957, PR #961): module-size 38544->39070 (+526), measured with `harness check-arch --json` (CLI 12.7.0) on this branch rebased onto main 23b5f01b, after #959 (#956) merged. The growth is the feature: a new `canary inventory` command (ts/src/inventory/inventory-cli.ts) that writes .canary/test-inventory.json in a documented, versioned schema, the pure builder that fills it (ts/src/core/test-inventory.ts), and the scorer that turns it into three of ci-ready's five checks (ts/src/core/inventory-checks.ts). Before this, those three checks could only ever report `skip`, because nothing produced their input; ADR 0026's partial-production disclosure in STRATEGY.md is removed in the same change because all five checks can now score. The builder reuses review-test's and vacuity-check's per-file enumeration and assertion vocabulary instead of a second traversal (three small helpers exported from ts/src/core/vacuity-scanner.ts), which is why the growth is 526 rather than a parser's worth more. Splitting would not reduce it: module-size is a repo-wide aggregate, so N files summing to 526 score the same as one. Nothing was absorbed here to avoid a fix. The two new threshold violations this branch first introduced were fixed in code, not allowed: `ts/src` at 13 files (the CLI module now lives in ts/src/inventory/, still in the `cli` layer via its ts/src/**/*cli*.ts pattern; check-deps passes, 137 modules), and `ts/src/analysis` at 1823 lines from an intermediate placement. The one remaining new violation, ts/src/history at 2013 lines, is not this branch's: #961 touches nothing under ts/src/history; it arrived on main with #959 and is tracked in #969, with the gate gap that let it merge tracked in #968. Perf ratchet: delta OK against the merge base (parseInventory split under the complexity rule in 0bd7c8d). No entropy entry point was declared and maxFindings was not touched.
